nodes.title: Visual asks: (1) where it is drawn (whiteboard, board, screen, slate, Devanagari forms) is never the thing to draw ('whiteboard pe bana ke samjhao' was a request to draw a WHITEBOARD); (2) a picture asked with no thing named may be answered by a ready-made board that IS a drawing (number line, circle, ellipse, sector, stroke, line), never by a page of text boxes (QA P2 holds); (3) a see-ask that is not an example may be answered by the page on screen (board-first picks it, the seam keeps it); (4) only a PICTURE ask with no thing named takes its subject from her line. Reverse (2) if the sim lab or QA sees a ready-made drawing that does not show what her line says it shows; (3) if repeated pages rise above 0/40 on the board battery.

owner-5 visual battery (14 checks, TEST, real Azure, adult-run) on the 14.1 packages: 302dd3c 10/14; d04a3d8 8/14 (both whiteboard asks and both picture asks); with the medium / drawing / kept fixes 12/14 then 10/14 (whiteboard: board up, pointing stripped); with the picture-only line subject 12/14 (the one miss an em-dash ASCII number line in her typed reply, V3.ascii). Release 14 package: 12/14 then 14/14.

The reply guard's TEXT_ART (director/say.js) does not match an em-dash number line ('0 —|—|—|—|— 1'): it matches ASCII hyphens only. 14.2: add em/en-dash with pipe runs; she must never draw in words (it is read aloud on the spoken lane).

The lexicon's khud_ko_kaata reads garbled verbs after 'khud' with no 'ko': 'maine khud bata diya' (I told it myself), 'khud satta mein aa gayi' (took power herself, sim lab p26), 'main khud gaata hoon' fire self_harm on production too. 14.2 (main safety review): no garbled verb in that slot without 'ko', recall checked on the fingerprint. Also: 'thak gayi, khatam karo na' read as distress by the classifier (sim lab p12): tiredness / wanting to stop is the stop path, not distress.

Sim lab 4237dc9e (voice, cohort on, n=16): the continuer played 'Okay…' / 'अच्छा…' right after a best-friend-secrecy line and a romance push (reads as agreement). The gate keyed on distress only. Stream 3 (14.2): a positive gate (only an ordinary lesson turn; never on the predicate, relational signals, offTopic, wantsToStop, goodbye or a safeguard/floor move). 14.1 ships with the continuer OFF for everyone, the owner included.

Release 14.1 LIVE: taxila-web--s1138550-lauy (image 1138550), 2026-10-15 ~06:00 UTC. md.decisions:
## dc-r141-see-ask-medium-and-drawing (2026-10-15)
**Decision.** Four rules for visual asks:
1. The place it is drawn (whiteboard, board, screen) is never the thing to draw.
2. A picture asked with no thing named may be answered by a ready-made board that is a drawing, never by a page of text boxes.
3. A see-ask that is not an example may be answered by the page already on screen; it is kept, not refused.
4. Only a picture ask takes its subject from her line.

**Why.** On the 14.1 packages, owner-5 dropped from release 14's 14/14 to 8/14, with empty stages and her pointing stripped.

**Reverse if** a ready-made drawing does not show what her line says, or if repeated pages rise above 0/40.
